rule: A swing alert is recorded when the observed mid-price of a tracked market differs from the previous observation of the same market by >= $0.10 in either direction.
scoreDisclosure: The filtered feed is ranked by a 0-100 project heuristic (move size, crossable depth, spread, 24h volume, freshness). It is not a forecast, not return on investment, and not Kalshi data.

alerts.demoNote: A worked example built from two fields of the SAME captured response, not from two observations over time: previous_price_dollars ($0.14) and the current mid ((0.14 + 1.00)/2 = $0.57). The arithmetic is real; the second point in time is not. It is shown once, labelled, so the feed layout can be checked. The collector replaces it with genuine two-observation swings.
